title: Order Types Supported
text: The platform supports Market, Limit, Stop, Stop-Limit, and Trailing Stop orders on all FX pairs and CFDs. Market orders execute at the best available price with slippage protection capped at 0.5 pips by default (configurable per account tier). Limit and Stop orders rest on the order book until triggered or cancelled, and expire automatically after 90 days unless Good-Till-Cancelled (GTC) is set.

title: Why an Order Was Rejected
text: Orders are rejected for one of five reasons: (1) insufficient margin, (2) price outside the current market band (>2% from last traded price), (3) instrument in an auction/halted state, (4) order size below the minimum lot (0.01 lots) or above the maximum per-order size for the instrument, or (5) account is in a restricted trading state (e.g. pending KYC re-verification). The rejection reason code is always returned in the order response payload under `reject_reason`.

title: How Margin Calls Work
text: A margin call is triggered when account equity falls below 100% of used margin. At 100%, the client receives a margin call notification. At 50% margin level, the platform begins auto-liquidating open positions starting with the largest unrealized loss until margin level is restored above 100%, or no positions remain. Margin level is recalculated in real time on every price tick, not on a fixed interval.

title: Leverage Tiers by Account Type
text: Retail accounts are capped at 1:30 leverage on major FX pairs, 1:20 on minors, and 1:10 on exotics, per standard retail investor protection rules. Professional (elective) accounts can access up to 1:200 leverage after passing the professional-client assessment (trading history, portfolio size, and financial sector experience criteria).

title: REST API Rate Limits
text: The REST API allows 120 requests per minute per API key for market data endpoints, and 60 requests per minute for order placement/modification endpoints. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header in seconds. Sustained abuse (>5 consecutive 429s) triggers a temporary 10-minute key suspension. WebSocket streaming does not count against the REST rate limit and is the recommended path for live price feeds.

title: Authenticating API Requests
text: API requests are authenticated with a bearer token obtained via OAuth2 client-credentials flow, valid for 24 hours. Tokens must be refreshed before expiry; there is no grace period after expiry, and an expired token returns HTTP 401 with error code `token_expired`. API keys can be scoped to read-only or trade-enabled at creation time in Account Settings > API Keys.

title: Price Feed Latency and Gaps
text: Live price ticks are delivered over WebSocket with typical end-to-end latency of 8-15ms during normal market hours. During high-volatility windows (major economic releases) latency can spike to 40-60ms and brief gaps (under 200ms) can occur as the feed re-synchronizes with the liquidity aggregator; this is expected behavior and does not indicate a feed outage unless the gap exceeds 3 seconds, which triggers an automatic stale-feed alert to the client's connected session.

title: KYC Verification Levels
text: Level 1 KYC (email + phone verification) allows demo trading only. Level 2 KYC (government ID + proof of address, reviewed within 1 business day) unlocks live trading up to $10,000 monthly deposit volume. Level 3 KYC (source-of-funds documentation, reviewed within 2-3 business days) removes the deposit cap and is required for professional-client status.

title: Why Trading Is Restricted After Re-verification Request
text: Accounts are periodically re-screened against updated sanctions and PEP (Politically Exposed Person) lists. If a partial match is flagged, the account is placed in a restricted state (existing positions remain open and can be closed, but new orders are blocked) until the compliance team clears the review, typically within 1-2 business days. This is a routine control, not an indication of wrongdoing.

title: Deposit and Withdrawal Processing Times
text: Card and e-wallet deposits are credited instantly to available balance. Bank wire deposits take 1-3 business days depending on the originating bank. Withdrawals to the original funding source are processed within 1 business day internally, but bank wire withdrawals can take an additional 2-5 business days to appear in the client's account depending on the receiving bank. Withdrawals are always returned to the original deposit method where possible, per standard anti-fraud policy.

title: Why a Withdrawal Was Delayed or Held
text: Withdrawals are held for manual review if: the withdrawal amount exceeds the account's total lifetime deposits, the destination payment method does not match a previously verified funding source, or the account has an open compliance flag. Held withdrawals are reviewed within 1 business day and the client is notified by email with the specific reason and any documents required to release it.

title: Fee Schedule Overview
text: Spreads start from 0.1 pips on major FX pairs on the Raw account tier (plus a fixed commission of $3.50 per lot per side), or from 1.0 pip with zero commission on the Standard account tier. Overnight positions incur a swap/rollover fee based on the interest rate differential between the two currencies, charged at 5pm New York time. An inactivity fee of $10/month applies after 90 days with no trading activity.

title: Supported Trading Platforms
text: The platform is accessible via the web trading terminal, native desktop app (Windows/macOS), mobile apps (iOS/Android), and via MetaTrader 5 bridge for clients who prefer MT5's charting and EA (Expert Advisor) ecosystem. All platforms share the same underlying account and execute against the same liquidity pool, so a position opened on mobile is immediately visible and manageable on web or MT5.

title: Trading Hours and Market Status
text: FX markets are open 24 hours a day, 5 days a week, from Sunday 22:00 UTC to Friday 22:00 UTC, with a brief liquidity gap around the Friday close / Sunday open where spreads widen significantly. Individual CFD instruments (indices, commodities) follow their underlying exchange's trading hours, shown in real time on the instrument's detail page as Open / Closed / Pre-Market.

title: Account Security and 2FA
text: Two-factor authentication (2FA) via authenticator app is mandatory for all live accounts and cannot be disabled once enabled without a support-verified identity check. Withdrawal requests always require a fresh 2FA confirmation regardless of session age. If a client loses access to their 2FA device, account recovery requires a video identity verification call with the security team, which is available 24/5 during market hours.
